data.name: Gatto's Pizzeria
data.detailed_description:
Make authentic Neapolitan pizzas in your grandfather’s restaurant!

In this cozy first-person cooking game, you can choose between 5 adorable cats and run a small pizzeria full of hungry human customers.

Cook every pizza step by step!

Prepare dough, slice fresh ingredients, organize your kitchen, and bake pizzas by hand using different cooking stations. Every order must be carefully prepared to keep customers happy and grow your reputation.

Manage the restaurant through morning, afternoon, and night!

Customers arrive during different phases of the day, each with their own orders. Learn new recipes, unlock ingredients, and upgrade your kitchen to cook faster and expand your menu.

Decorate and upgrade your pizzeria!

Unlock new tables, ovens, and decorations to transform the old family restaurant into a warm and lively Italian pizzeria.

Relax while you cook!

Enjoy a cozy experience with hand-drawn 3D visuals, a relaxing atmosphere, and gameplay focused on cooking, decorating, and making your customers happy.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz Quad-core Intel or AMD processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 470 GTX or AMD Radeon 6870 HD
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 750 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: The game includes graphics settings to aid lower end devices.
